records.text: Before he had much fame, Charlie Kirk was required to have security with him at all times, and Bill Montgomery arranged that security.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I maintain my belief that Charlie was being monitored by the government since he was young and it was Bill Montgomery who organized and initially paid, you should know. for the full-time security that Charlie would need. He arranged that. Bill Montgomery chose to hire Shaffer Security, which was run by Greg Shaffer.

So I would say obviously turning point was an organization, but it wasn't the organization. It wasn't this behemoth of an organization that it became. No, he had no real degree of fame. I think that's fair. But he was required to have security on him at all times. That was orchestrated. His security, Schaefer's security was orchestrated by Bill Montgomery.

verification.notes: Live searches found public accounts of Bill Montgomery's early mentorship and organizational role at Turning Point USA, but no reliable source establishing that Kirk was required to have security at all times before fame or that Montgomery arranged Schaefer Security. Owens cites private texts, which are not independently authenticated.

records.text: Turning Point USA was established in part by Bill Montgomery, who was involved with the Air Force.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I think he was obviously we can prove that he was tracked by the military. I mean, turning point was established in part by Bill Montgomery, who was Air Force involved with the Air Force.

verification.notes: Reliable reporting confirms William Montgomery co-founded Turning Point USA with Charlie Kirk, and Montgomery's obituary records service in the U.S. Air Force Reserve. 'Partly established' and 'Air Force involvement' are therefore supported, though the latter should not imply institutional sponsorship.
